study_scope: Four P0: seedless tamarind, cow/buffalo colostrum, Narikela Ksheerika, Ksheerapaka. Product-identity vs original CTR legal maximum deliberately separated.

primary_ayurveda_law.title: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahara) Regulations, 2022
primary_ayurveda_law.category_A_presumption: Only where actual marketed item proves exact listed text recipe; generic listing does not approve it; no CTR exemption.

published_version_conflict.resolution: 2025 order must be checked as latest applicable recipe; avoid mixing older compendium process/category. Exact interpretation and manufacturer evidence outstanding.

cases.confirmed_identity: Tamarindus indica L. mature ripe fruit after removing outer covering and seeds. Moisture maximum 20%, seeds maximum 0.5%, organic extraneous matter maximum 5%: product quality/identity conditions only.
cases.scope_exclusion: FPSFA 2.3.18 Tamarind Pulp/Puree/Concentrate is a different processed article (boiling, sieving, heat processing or preservation). Copper CTR comparator for fruit pulp must not be transferred from an article name alone.
cases.specific_next_proof: Actual Tamarindus indica batch form: whole seedless versus pulp/puree/concentrate, additives/processing/BOM, signed exact operative copper food-category Gazette, method/laboratory and lot report.

cases.product_clause: FPSFA 2.1.23 Cow or Buffalo Colostrum Products and 2.1.1 Milk definition
cases.confirmed_identity: Colostrum: cow/buffalo mammary secretion up to three to five days from parturition, before regular milk production; colostrum powder is derived by drying. FPSFA 2.1.1 defines ordinary milk as free from colostrum.
cases.scope_exclusion: Colostrum is NOT ordinary milk for product identity even though dairy general principles are cross-referenced; raw colostrum and concentrated powder require different matrix/basis decisions. Ordinary milk CTR lead row is not automatically the legal comparator.
cases.specific_next_proof: Species, post-calving collection interval, raw vs powder product, concentration/moisture and permitted ingredients, original operative CTR lead commodity standard and signed laboratory method/matrix/representative lot.
cases.product_name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products

cases.product_clause: Ayurveda Aahara 2022 Regulation 3 / FSSAI 25 July 2025 Category A Recipe 14.3
cases.confirmed_identity: 2025 Recipe 14.3 Narikela Ksheerika (Ashita/eatable) specifies Godugdha (cow milk, 1 part) with coconut endosperm (Cocos nucifera) as required, cooked down to a thick consistency, then cut into portions.
cases.scope_exclusion: This named Ayurvedic dairy-coconut composite is neither coconut milk powder nor pure dairy milk; older Ayurveda compendium lists a different presentation (Pana/drinkable). The source-version/recipe conflict must be checked instead of mixing entries. No milk lead maximum transferred.
cases.specific_next_proof: Identity and exact 2025 Order revision versus older recipe, authentic category-A ingredient/BOM and heat/cooling/packaging/label, actual dairy species, applicable original CTR lead category/processing basis, lab CoA.

cases.product_clause: Ayurveda Aahara 2022 Regulation 3 / FSSAI 25 July 2025 Category A Recipe 14.7
cases.confirmed_identity: 2025 Recipe 14.7 Ksheerapaka (Mystic Milk Quartet) specifies Mahishi Ksheera (buffalo milk 1 part), aromatic flowers (infused then removed), water, and sugar, with low-heat concentration and further slow cooking.
cases.scope_exclusion: The recipe is not legally identical to plain milk or milk powder; milk is one ingredient of a cooked composite. No original CTR lead comparator, analyte test basis, process concentration or final manufactured material is authenticated.
cases.specific_next_proof: Exact buffalo milk source, flowers species and removal, water/sugar proportions, final concentration/BOM, as-sold form & manufacturing process, category-A recipe interpretation and case-specific original CTR lead limit/matrix lab CoA.

disclosure: FSSAI compendia explicitly are not legal original Gazette. The 2025 Ayurveda recipe order text comes from search-indexed official FSSAI publication and has not been fully page rendered. Signed current CTR applicability, marketed product identity, laboratory matrix, and original lot CoA remain missing.
